description_en: Queries the details of processed vulnerabilities
kebab_example: aliyun mssp get-vul-list-by-id --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --id 4209205 --dealed n --necessity asap,later,nntf --remark production_nat_cn-hangzhou_zone_105 --uuids 3615b908-995a-4edb-bc85-1981b4e94ba0,9c52cf9a-d8ba-4e31-ae06-500b879ee4e6,4b7de3cf-c4ac-42fc-8804-35070493dc29,f3c01525-0777-4c97-88d9-bec11afd4a6a,a80bd516-c4f3-4c27-a169-c8abfaf9e89e --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVulListById

parameters.description_en: The number of the current page.
parameters.help_en: The number of the current page
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability has been processed. Valid values:

- y: processed
- n: not processed.
parameters.description_zh: 是否已处理；y:已处理；n:未处理

parameters.description_en: The asset information of the vulnerability to query. You can set this parameter to the asset name, public IP address, or private IP address.
